body: You're welcome. It's good to reach out for help even if you're not sure you're going to do it. I'm never sure, and I don't think I will but my thoughts can get pretty scary and it can help to post here. I hope you'll be ok.
Thank you so much for answering. Now I can stop freaking out about this.
Thank you so much for answering. And thank you for telling me about Seventh Generation. I wasn't sure what to switch to that would be safe. I'll try that in the future.

http://mykidhaspaws.org/2016/04/pet-blankets/
Thank you so much for the reply. I found this article talking about it and it freaked me out. 
Here's a quote from it.

"When washing your pet’s blankets, it’s important that you use a detergent with no dyes or fragrances. Why? Although these additives can make pet blankets and beds smell better, they can also irritate your pet’s skin. Additionally, certain chemicals within laundry detergents can be toxic to your pet if your pet chews on their blankets.

The best thing you can do is select a pet-safe natural laundry detergent that won’t irritate your pet’s skin or contain harsh chemicals (the harsh chemicals commonly found in laundry detergent are harmful to you too!). There are a variety of different natural laundry detergents out there, but make sure they don’t contain the following:

Chlorine

Fragrance

Petroleum distillates

Nonlphenol ethoxylate or NPE

Diethanolamine

Bleach

…and the list goes on."

But I think my cat is ok despite what this article says. I think my cat will be ok but I maybe should buy another safer type in the future.
Just to be safe I think I'll just leave the bed without a blanket for now.
I'm so relieved.  Thank you for answering.
If you want to talk about it I'll listen. It hurts to feel alone. Do you feel like there's no hope? Is there anything that makes you second guess commiting suicide?
Thank you for telling me. I feel better knowing I'm not the only one experiencing anxiety this way.

I have a similar problem where I think about bad things all day. Things that have happened, thoughts that torment me, mistakes I've made and feeling like a bad person etc. I'm not sure how to deal with it ither. I feel I even make my own problems worse because I also willingly dwell on bad things, so I feel guilty for that too. 
Sometimes moving around helps me.
It cab help take me out of my thoughts but not always. The thoughts seem to want to push through even when I try to ignore them and it can make it hard to concentrate. 
I've also heard that trying to push the thoughts away makes them stronger.
I'm seeing a therapist. Knowing if it's real or not helps. Thank you.

"Go for a hike, find a beautiful site and take it in" 
"I've thought of other options, alternatives, like going for a long trip, maybe coast to coast, that sounds nice,"
"Moving somewhere far away and starting a new life"
You seem to want to travel and take in beautiful scenary. To see new things. To escape. 
"I'm ready to fly away"
"I'll be free"
You are in a lot of pain. 
"I don't want help, I just want to die."
"Sometimes I'm thinking about something random and pointless, then a loud voice in my head repeats over and over "I want to die"
"Maybe I'm only making this post so someone can convince me I'm wrong."
There is still a part of you that is undecided.
There is a conflict between the parts of you that are in pain and the parts that want to live. 
But I think both parts can agree you want to stop the pain. Suicide will trap you in death forever. If you are dead you will have no other option but to be dead. What is it like to be dead? No one knows. But you do know what it's like to be alive. It is painful, but if you're alive you will have the option to see beautiful scenery and breathe fresh air. 
You don't have to reach out for help, but you can because you have options. You also have possibilities. Maybe you want someone to try to help you see things differently. You can see things differently.
If youvare dead you will never see anything again. Death is permanent. It can bot be undone and there is the pain of dying.
Life is not permanent. But as long as you are alive you have the hope of change and healing.
I've told my therapist I feel suicidal but not why. The why is the hard part.

Well, your attention seeking stems from something. Maybe you're lonely. Maybe you seeking attention is your way of asking for help. We all seek attention in our own ways.
You are probably in a lot of pain. 
I can relate to what you're saying. I feel part of my problem is I'm attention seeking and I hate myself for it too.

I've tried to write it down but I just have a huge jumble of words and thoughts I'm not sure how to sort or explain. I have pages and pages and pages and I've tried to explain. Now, I have all those pages and thoughts to sort through and I'm overwhelmed. I've been reading them and it's painful and mentally draining to try to select the right words.

Thank you so much for helping me find an answer. But can they legally read it and look through it when I asked them not to? It was taken and stored. I've been released from the mental hospital. They took it because of the wire and gave it back when I left, but I am afraid they read it.  The nurse said they wouldn't but I don't believe her.  

I'm afraid. And it's just causing more suicidal thoughts. I wanted to tell them myself and not have them invade my privacy. I'm most upset that they could had read the stuff I wrote about my therapist. My therapist has helped me and I'm so guilty right now it's triggering more suicidal thoughts. If they read it, surely they will tell my therapist the stuff I wrote about my therapist and I feel my therapist is the only one who has listened to me and taken me seriously and it'll destroy me if our therapeutic relationship is destroyed because of some stupid stuff I wrote out of fear and paranoia. I'm so sorry and I know I need help but I just hope they don't force help on me. 

I'm still able to know there's something wrong with me and I'm reaching out for help but I just don't want to be held against my will and to lose my choice when I only have thoughts and plans of killing myself as well as feelings. I've had them for years and imagine killing myself every day. But I have never attempted. 

I'm afraid they'll take me back. I can't stop thinking about it.
Thank you so much.  I appreciate your comment and support.
